mount-tam-and-point-reyes.title: Mount Tam and Point Reyes
mount-tam-and-point-reyes.slogan: A 140 km loop out of Mount Tamalpais road

pl-dunajec-and-pieniny-route.slogan: Dunajec and Pieniny Route – 40 km between Nowy Sącz and Niedzica
pl-dunajec-and-pieniny-route.story: A natural corridor of river bends, cliffs and historic settlements. It also links naturally to Pieniny National Park.

scenicChapters.title: Tatra Foothills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 13 km this is Tatra Foothills Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
